title: The Gold Myth That Drains Your Wealth

beats.say: Holding gold for 20 years lost buyers nearly 80% against inflation between 1980 and 2000.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of a tarnished gold bar under cold sodium light, empty vault.

beats.say: Most people assume a shiny heavy metal is the safest fortress for hard-earned money.
beats.visual: Low angle of a heavy steel vault door half-closed against deep shadow.

beats.say: Why does an asset everyone trusts end up dragging your portfolio into the dirt?
beats.visual: Silhouette of a person staring up at a massive concrete monolith in pouring rain.

beats.say: Gold produces nothing. It just sits there collecting dust while businesses actually work.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of rusted industrial gears half-buried in wet mud.

beats.say: Look at what happens when you put real cash to work instead of buying shiny rocks.
beats.visual: High angle shot of dark wet asphalt under a single flickering street lamp.

beats.say: If you invest $500 a month at 8% a year, you hit $745,180 in 30 years.
beats.visual: Close-up of a gloved hand flipping a page in a dark ledger by practical light.

beats.say: Or look at a 40-year timeline with that same monthly amount.
beats.visual: Extreme wide of a foggy highway cutting through a dark, empty mountain ridge.

beats.say: That same $500 a month at 8% a year grows to $1,745,504 in 40 years.
beats.visual: Low angle of a towering concrete bridge pier against a cold blue-hour sky.

beats.say: Can gold ever match the compounding power of income-producing assets over decades?
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of water droplets sliding down a cold metal pipe at night.

beats.say: It cannot. Gold sits idle while businesses pump out profits and dividends year after year.
beats.visual: Silhouette of a worker walking across a vast open-air shipping yard in fog.

beats.say: Trade dead metal for assets that work. Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: Extreme wide of a single practical street lamp cutting through deep night fog.

caption: Gold isn't the wealth builder you think it is. #money #personalfinance #investing #wealth
description: Over long periods, unproductive commodities like gold drag down portfolio growth compared to income-producing assets.
first_comment: What asset do you trust the most for the long haul?
